1. Survey Objectives
This survey is designed to assess the commercial opportunity for BRINSUPRI (brensocatib; Insmed) in non-cystic fibrosis bronchiectasis (NCFB). Specific objectives include:
Understand current prescribing patterns, visit frequency, patient funnel, and patient selection criteria for BRINSUPRI in NCFB
Assess future prescribing intent and anticipated share trajectory
Evaluate diagnostic trends: how frequently pulmonologists are identifying NCFB in patients previously labeled as COPD or asthma, and how this is expected to evolve
Prescribing patterns and experience (including patient feedback/experience, phenotype(s) of patients RX'd BRINSUPRI, payer/prior auth experience) - including disonctinuations (rate, reason, plans to restart/retry)
Test the market expansion thesis: (a) conversion of patients with <2 pulmonary exacerbations (PE) per year to 2+ PE over time, and (b) potential for increased BRINSUPRI use as NCFB diagnosis rates improve
Must capture to inform model: peak penetration, speed of uptake / to peak, potential for expansion beyond base case (i.e., trial population of 2+ PE in a year)
2. Survey Type
Demand estimation study
The survey is designed to establish physician-level prescribing behavior, quantify eligible patient pools, and model peak sales potential for BRINSUPRI in NCFB across the diagnosed and potentially diagnosable patient population.
3. Sample Size and Respondent Types
N = 50 pulmonologists with active NCFB patient management experience. No specialty quota required (pulmonology only). Soft quota on practice setting recommended.
